title: How is LeBron James connected to Kim Jong Un?
description:
Five real photos connect LeBron James to North Korea's Kim Jong Un, through Kobe Bryant, two American presidents and South Korea's president.

LeBron James → Kobe Bryant → Barack Obama → Donald Trump → Moon Jae-in → Kim Jong Un

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

Photo credits:
Photo 1 by Erik Drost, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:LeBron_James_vs._Kobe_Bryant_-_24336452934.jpg
Photo 2 by Pete Souza, Chief Official White House Photographer, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kobe_Bryant_and_Barack_Obama_Dec_2015.jpg
Photo 3 by Staff Sgt. Marianique Santos, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Obama_hands_over_presidency_to_Trump_at_58th_Presidential_Inauguration_170120-D-NA975-0947.jpg
Photo 4 by Natig Sharifov, CC0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Donald_J._Trump_welcomes_President_Moon_Jae-in_of_the_Republic_of_Korea_to_the_White_House_(35520219101).jpg
Photo 5 by Cheongwadae / Blue House, KOGL Type 1: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2018_inter-Korean_summit_01.jpg
